notes: Project country: Germany (Leipzig, DIN title block 'luka architekten', metric m/cm dimension convention, scale 1:100 stated on every sheet). Calculation profile DE.
Sheet set: one project 'Sanierung EFH Lausicker Str. 26, 04299 Leipzig', Entwurfsplanung, dated 11.06.2012. All sheets scale 1:100, metric, no rotation.

Page classification: p1 = section (Schnitt, 1:100); p2 = elevations NW/SW (1:100); p3 = elevations SO/NO (1:100); p4 = roof/attic plan Spitzboden (1:100); p5 = floor plan DG (1:100); p6 = floor plan OG (1:100); p7 = floor plan EG (1:100); p8 = floor plan KG (1:100).

Elevation mapping: entrance door, portal and entry stair are on 'Ansicht von Nordosten' -> front = NO elevation. back = SW (Suedwesten), left = SO (Suedosten, as seen from street), right = NW (Nordwesten).

Red/yellow drawn elements are PLANNED alterations (Entwurf overlay on Ist drawings): solar panels, exterior stair on SW side, roof window on SO roof face (SK-3), sill lowerings ('Bruestung abbrechen, BRH neu'). SK-3 is included and flagged as planned.

Vertical datum ±0.00 = grade at street/entrance (NO) side. Site slopes down toward SW/SO to ca. -1.13. Elevation-local y=0 is the local grade line of that elevation; sills additionally referenced in low_reason/notes.
Building is a 1930s-type villa: 2 full storeys (EG+OG) plus habitable DG under a steep hip roof plus Spitzboden and full basement.
Opening sizes/positions without written dimensions were measured graphically at the stated 1:100 scale (source estimated, confidence low).

warnings: Red/yellow drawn elements (solar panels, SW exterior stair, roof window SK-3, sill lowerings) are PLANNED alterations of the Sanierung design, not necessarily existing; SK-3 is included and flagged.

Sloped site: grade varies from ca. -1,13 (SW/SO) to +0,12⁵ (NO). Per-elevation eave/ridge heights and wall areas use local average grade; single building heights refer to datum ±0.00 (street side), not the lowest grade point.

Garage floor area label 'BF 22,36 m2' (p7) is inconsistent with the chain-derived envelope 3,52 x 6,41⁵ m; the chain-derived envelope (elevations p2/p3) was preferred per cross-sheet consistency rule.

Opening sizes and positions largely lack written dimensions on the elevations; they were measured graphically at the stated 1:100 scale (source estimated, confidence low). Written BRH values from floor plans were used for sills where available.
Roof pitch not explicitly dimensioned as an angle; 44,3° derived from level marks Traufe +7,34⁵ / First +12,22⁵ and half-depth 5,00 m; roof-plan 12/12-type pitch marks (~45°) agree within tolerance.
Downspouts are not clearly drawn on any elevation; downspouts array left empty (no drops reported).
Roof plan p4 shows additional small red/yellow roof hatch/opening symbols along the Spitzboden corridor that could not be reliably identified; not modeled.
Fascia height and garage door/veranda glazing details are graphic estimates only (no written dimensions).
